source.title: Claude Code Stop decision:block synthetic input does not fire UserPromptSubmit

acquisition.details: Created isolated Claude Code settings with a UserPromptSubmit hook appending stdin JSON to logs/upshook.jsonl and a Stop hook that logs stdin to logs/stophook.jsonl, then on the first Stop returns JSON {decision:block, reason:"CC_STOP_INJECTED_PROMPT_MARKER_20260509", systemMessage:"extra-eyes validation injected one follow-up turn"}. Ran `claude --print --verbose --output-format stream-json --include-hook-events --settings /tmp/eyes-validation/cc-stop-inject/settings.json --permission-mode bypassPermissions --max-budget-usd 0.50 "Reply with only FIRST."`. Stream output showed a synthetic user message containing the Stop hook feedback marker, then a second assistant turn. Logs: upshook.jsonl has exactly 1 row for the original prompt `Reply with only FIRST.`; stophook.jsonl has 2 rows, first with last_assistant_message=FIRST and second with stop_hook_active=true plus last_assistant_message=`Acknowledged the marker. No action requested.`. The injected marker does not appear in upshook.jsonl.
